blogs.title: QLoRA in Plain English: How 4-Bit Finetuning Put Giant LLMs on a Single GPU
blogs.description: A friendly overview of QLoRA: what it is, why it matters, and how it makes 65B-parameter models trainable on one 48GB GPU without losing accuracy. Covers the big idea—freeze the model, add tiny adapters, and train through 4-bit weights.

blogs.title: Meet Guanaco: An Open-Source Chatbot That Nearly Matches ChatGPT
blogs.description: A results-focused story on the Guanaco models finetuned with QLoRA. Explains how 24 hours on a single GPU delivered 99.3% of ChatGPT’s performance on Vicuna, what that means for the community, and where the model still struggles.

blogs.title: The Magic of NF4: Why a New 4-Bit Data Type Keeps Big Models Smart
blogs.description: A digestible deep dive into NormalFloat (NF4): how information-theoretic quantization tailored to normal weight distributions beats FP4/Int4, preserves accuracy, and enables robust 4-bit training.

blogs.title: Double Quantization Explained: Squeezing Memory Without Squeezing Performance
blogs.description: An accessible breakdown of double quantization—quantizing the quantizers. Shows how this trims ~0.37 bits per parameter (about 3 GB on 65B models) and why it doesn’t hurt downstream results.

blogs.title: Paged Optimizers: The Safety Net That Stops Out-of-Memory Crashes
blogs.description: A practical explainer on paged optimizers using NVIDIA unified memory to ride out activation spikes. Covers when paging kicks in, why training speed stays intact, and how it unlocks long-sequence batches.

blogs.title: From Lab to Laptop: A Practical Guide to Finetuning LLMs with QLoRA
blogs.description: Step-by-step guidance for practitioners. What hardware you need, how LoRA adapters fit in, which layers to adapt, and the hyperparameters that helped QLoRA match 16-bit baselines—even on 7B–65B models.

blogs.title: Small but Mighty Data: Why Quality Beats Quantity in Instruction Tuning
blogs.description: A data-centric take: how a 9k-sample, high-quality dataset outperformed a 450k-sample alternative for chatbot performance. Explores dataset-task fit and why MMLU strength does not guarantee strong chat behavior.

blogs.title: Can GPT-4 Judge Other Models? What Human vs. AI Evaluations Reveal
blogs.description: An evaluation explainer. Walks through pairwise Elo tournaments, ordering effects found in GPT-4 judgments, agreement levels with human raters, and when AI-based evaluation is a good (or risky) proxy.

blogs.title: Why 4-Bit Training Works: Recovering 16-Bit Performance with Adapters
blogs.description: A concept-first technical post on backprop through quantized weights into LoRA adapters. Explains how QLoRA maintains 16-bit accuracy across tasks and architectures, and where FP4 lags NF4.

blogs.title: The Bigger Picture: How QLoRA Democratizes LLM Finetuning
blogs.description: A perspective piece on accessibility and impact—single-GPU finetuning for 33B/65B models, mobile and privacy-preserving potentials, open-source kernels, and the dual-use considerations.
